environment.description: Same image-processor:2.4.1 deployed in production-main namespace. Split.io workspace 'prod-main' has the flag 'enable-native-image-resize' defined with default treatment 'off' and kill switch activated (flag status: killed since 2024-01-15). Individual targeting rules exist but are superseded by the killed state per Split SDK evaluation precedence (killed flags return the configured off-treatment regardless of targeting rules). The native library libimageproc.so IS present in the container for rollback capability. Environment variable SPLIT_SDK_KEY points to prod-main workspace API key. Split SDK streaming connection verified healthy via /health/split internal endpoint. Flag definition includes a stale-flag alert if anyone attempts to modify targeting rules while in killed state.

config.targeting_rules_note: Rules exist but are not evaluated when flag is in killed state per Split SDK semantics
